author: Ronak Dave
title: Hiring 3D artist for D2C product renders
content: We’re looking to collaborate with a 3D Artist. We have a few upcoming D2C product projects and are looking for a skilled artist who can create: • Premium, photorealistic 3D product renders • 3D motion & animations • Product packshots & campaign visuals • Social media-ready 3D content If you can turn a product brief into high-impact visual experiences, we’d love to see your work. 📩 DM us with your portfolio, availability & commercials. Freelancers / independent artists welcome.
